active_contracted_residuals.inputs: 2D engineering drawing plus dimensions and feature callouts
active_contracted_residuals.environment_state: CAD construction environment and geometry kernel
active_contracted_residuals.allowed_information: task instruction, visible drawing/data, general CAD knowledge and Brain-owned/open non-task-specific mechanisms
active_contracted_residuals.required_output_or_action: construct a 3D solid matching the drawing's global envelope, topology, mass properties, and curvature
active_contracted_residuals.success_condition: independent global volume, surface area, inertia, convex hull, Euler topology, and curvature checks pass
active_contracted_residuals.failure_condition: one or more required global geometry metrics materially diverge
active_contracted_residuals.terminal_consequence: required for fresh agentic coding tasks whose correctness depends on global geometric interpretation
active_contracted_residuals.verification_route: independent geometry oracle over frozen candidate
active_contracted_residuals.scope: engineering drawing to CAD solid reconstruction

active_contracted_residuals.inputs: credit derivative trade notional, effective/maturity dates, direction, supervisory factor/correlation, margin state and MPOR
active_contracted_residuals.environment_state: SA-CCR netting set under declared day-count and maturity-factor convention
active_contracted_residuals.allowed_information: visible portfolio/input files, task instruction, authoritative/general regulatory method knowledge
active_contracted_residuals.required_output_or_action: compute supervisory duration when applicable, d_adj, delta, maturity factor, effective notional, then asset-class aggregation without omitting any applicable method factor
active_contracted_residuals.success_condition: independent intermediate-lineage audit and held-out portfolio results agree within declared tolerances
active_contracted_residuals.failure_condition: an applicable factor is missing from the calculation graph or intermediate/output values diverge materially
active_contracted_residuals.terminal_consequence: required for financial-analysis and coding tasks implementing structured regulatory or quantitative methods
active_contracted_residuals.verification_route: independent calculation graph with intermediate factor checks; not a recomputation sharing builder formulas
active_contracted_residuals.dependency_boundary: deterministic once the applicable method rules are structured; semantic rule retrieval/selection is separate
active_contracted_residuals.scope: structured quantitative methods with explicit intermediate factors

active_contracted_residuals.inputs: raw task instruction, visible files/data/drawings, and JIT authoritative domain rules when required
active_contracted_residuals.environment_state: pre-builder task state with hidden verifier/solution unavailable
active_contracted_residuals.allowed_information: task-visible evidence plus allowed general/JIT authoritative knowledge
active_contracted_residuals.required_output_or_action: produce a complete normalized set of applicable requirements, factors, constraints, exclusions, required intermediates and output relations
active_contracted_residuals.success_condition: on held-out tasks, every material independently knowable acceptance requirement is present with correct applicability and source basis
active_contracted_residuals.failure_condition: a material visible or authoritatively retrievable requirement/factor is omitted, mis-scoped, or incorrectly excluded
active_contracted_residuals.terminal_consequence: required because deterministic coverage checking cannot detect a rule that never entered the structured requirement graph
active_contracted_residuals.verification_route: held-out spent/noncontaminating tasks scored against post-freeze independent oracles; ablate extraction mechanism and measure requirement recall
active_contracted_residuals.dependency_boundary: deterministic parsing/retrieval should be subtracted first; only semantic residual may remain learned
active_contracted_residuals.scope: open-ended tasks whose requirements are expressed in natural language, diagrams, schemas, standards or heterogeneous visible evidence

active_contracted_residuals.inputs: frozen structured requirement graph plus task-visible evidence
active_contracted_residuals.allowed_information: no builder internals as sole authority; no hidden verifier/solution
active_contracted_residuals.required_output_or_action: derive discriminating exact-oracle, invariant, boundary, metamorphic, alternative-interpretation, dimensional/type, or external-authority checks for every material requirement
active_contracted_residuals.success_condition: held-out builder mistakes that violate an independently knowable requirement are detected before terminal submission
active_contracted_residuals.failure_condition: checks merely recompute builder assumptions or fail to distinguish a material wrong interpretation
active_contracted_residuals.terminal_consequence: required to prevent systematic self-certification and clean-evidence waste
active_contracted_residuals.verification_route: freeze checks before builder validation and measure detection on held-out spent failures and synthetic adversarial mutations
active_contracted_residuals.dependency_boundary: deterministic check execution/coverage is owned; semantic check synthesis remains open
active_contracted_residuals.scope: consequential tasks with multiple plausible implementations or interpretations
